primary.title: Gold, silver prices today: Comex gold drops $84, silver slips $2 as US dollar rebounds
primary.summary: Gold and silver prices fell on 31 July amid a stronger US dollar and hawkish Federal Reserve comments. Gold lost $84 per ounce but remained 1.5% higher for July, while silver declined to $57.22, tracking a 4% drop for the month.
